items.title: Prompt Architecture
items.content: A strong prompt is structured around role, task, context, tone, format, and optional goal.

items.title: Context-Based Prompting
items.content: Provide relevant background, situation, inputs, and goal before the task so the model can produce a more relevant response.

items.title: One/Few-Shot Prompting
items.content: Examples can anchor style, format, and consistency when the output needs to follow a clear pattern.

items.title: Advanced Prompt Techniques
items.content: Advanced techniques include structured outputs, constraints, iterative refinement, meta-prompting, and context-window management.
